meanings: the Blood of the Sky (Naelthar's epithet, as Seren gives it)
derivation: a phrase, the construct of orrowen_v2 §3.10 ('X of the Y'): lorr 'blood' (*lorr-o-s > Hal lorros > lorr, canon) + Helv, S·helv 'the sky' (*half-i-s > Hal helvis > helv, canon; h is unchanged by the softening), the possessor softened (§3.2); built as Molt Hyll 'the Tide-Heart'; unit S11

meanings: the Bearer of Branches (Leavaren's epithet, as Seren gives it)
derivation: a phrase, the construct: lymmerd 'a bearer' (lymm 'bring; bear, carry' < *luʔmm- (reserve: Hal lymmis > lymm) + -Ard, O1314) + Yendeth, S·gendeth 'branches' (gend 'a shoot from a stump; a branch, a bough' < *geʔnd- (reserve: Hal gendos > gend) + -Ath, slender -eth), the possessor softened, g > y before a vowel (§3.3); unit S11
logogram: PAR+course (98) + A r d · MESK+bough (191) + A th

meanings: the Burning (Esthaer's epithet, as Seren gives it; apposition: Esthaer Vorrol)
derivation: vorrol 'burning; the act of burning' (vorr 'fire; burn' < *forr-o-s > Hal vorros > vorr, canon; the verb by zero derivation, lexicon §4.4) + -Ol, broad -ol: the verbal noun as a name, in apposition (orrowen_v2 §3.10, 'X the Y', as Kael Nydherd), as Lennet 'the Silvered' is the participle; the same form as unit S05's row S05-09; unit S11

meanings: the Grain That Rots (Vaelress's epithet)
derivation: a phrase, the relative epithet: meskdhrenn 'the grain of wood' (mesk + S trenn, O1383) + sa REL(+S) + Lilv, lilv 'soft; rot, go soft' (*liʔlf- (reserve): Hal lilvos > lilv; l is unchanged by the softening); unit S11

meanings: the Long Winter (Eirlenth's epithet)
derivation: a phrase: grem 'winter' (*grem-i-s > Hal gremis > grem, canon) + sell 'long' (*sell-i-s > Hal sellis > sell, canon); the adjective follows its noun and does not mutate (§3.1, §3.3); unit S11

meanings: the Lone Stroke (a root of the grain, as Seren names it)
derivation: a phrase: stinel 'a stroke, a single cut' (stin 'cut' < *stin- (reserve: Hal stinos > stin) + -el, O2375) + hosel 'one, alone, single' (hos + -el, O0990); unit S11

meanings: the Bar Before (a root of the grain, as Seren names it)
derivation: a phrase: hosk 'a lintel; a bar, a stone laid across' (*hosk-o-s > Hal hoskos > hosk, canon) + ul lern 'before, in front' (ul + N lern 'the face', O2631); unit S11

meanings: the Mute Square (a root of the grain, as Seren names it)
derivation: a phrase: gemmyorn 'a square' (gemm 'four' + S gorn 'a corner', O0719) + nawrodh 'mute' (na- + S brodh, O1727), as tolmath nawrodh 'the mute stones'; unit S11

meanings: the Two Mouths (a root of the grain, as Seren names it)
derivation: a phrase, the dual of §3.2: pa 'two' (+S) + S·brodow 'a mouth' (brod 'a word' + -ow 'place', O0188; b > w), as pa yarl 'two hands'; unit S11

meanings: the Turned Stern (a root of the grain, as Seren names it)
derivation: a phrase: sestow 'the back; the stern of a hull' (sest 'a shoulder' + -ow, O2287) + kylet 'turned' (kyl 'change; curl, turn; hook, turn back' (canon) + -At, O1131); unit S11

meanings: the Smoothed Cut (a root of the grain, as Seren names it)
derivation: a phrase: stinel 'a stroke, a single cut' (O2375) + dasorat 'polished, rubbed smooth' (dasor 'polish, rub smooth' < *dasor- (reserve: Hal dasoris > dasor) + -At, O0372); unit S11

meanings: the Fall (the fall of the Shorelands, before the Book): et Ommol
derivation: ommol 'falling' (omm 'fall' (*omm-o-s > Hal ommos > omm, canon) + -Ol, O1869), the verbal noun made the name of the event, with the article as et Hosk 'the Title'; unit S11

meanings: wait on, wait for (the one who is to move first): cedh re dhovv um hedh, 'who waited on whom'
derivation: a phrase: tovv 'wait, stay' (*toff-o-s > Hal tovvos > tovv, canon) + um 'upon' (+S, canon), as the feelings are laid 'upon' (§3.7); unit S11

meanings: show ('give the sight of'): hebb veskyl X lo Y, show X to Y; Hebba lont veskyl et cryrull, 'show them the host'
derivation: a phrase: hebb 'give' (*habb-i-s > Hal hebbis > hebb, canon) + veskyl 'sight' (vesk 'see' (canon) + -Ol, O2735): the tongue has no causative, and makes 'show' from a verb and a verbal noun as it makes 'can' and 'must' (§3.7); unit S11

meanings: let (X do Y): lusk X ul VN, 'loose X in V-ing'; Luska et vorr ul vorrol, 'let the fire work (burn)'
derivation: a phrase: lusk 'loose, let go, set free' (*lusk-o-s > Hal luskos > lusk, canon) + ul 'in' (+N) + a verbal noun, the progressive's own shape (§3.4, Doss et hald ul glennol); unit S11

meanings: side by side ('shoulder at shoulder')
derivation: a phrase: sest 'the shoulder' (*seʔst- (reserve): Hal sestos > sest) + lo 'at' (+S; s is unchanged) + sest, built as hos eth hos 'one by one'; unit S11

meanings: a prize, a thing coveted ('a thing wanted'); wished, wanted (the participle)
derivation: maver 'wish, want; a need' (*mafer- (reserve): Hal maveros > maver) + -At, slender -et: the participle as a noun, as hebbet 'a gift' and tesset 'a Judgement' (lexicon §4.2, verb + -At); the noun sense is new, the form is O1355; unit S11

meanings: reach, range (of guns: as far as their fire comes in); coming in, arriving (the verbal noun)
derivation: mellor 'come in, arrive; reach' (*maillor- (reserve): Hal melloros > mellor) + -Ol, broad -ol: the verbal noun as the thing (lexicon §4.2, verb + -Ol, 'the doing, and the thing'); the noun sense is new, the form is O1364; unit S11

meanings: long before ('long early'): sell tevar hy X, long before X
derivation: a phrase: sell 'long' (canon) + tevar 'early, before the time' (*tefar- (reserve): Hal tevaros > tevar); hy 'than' makes the comparison (lexicon §5.3, strom hy X); unit S11

meanings: the two flanks of a host, both sides ('the two shoulders'); et pa sest, the flanks: grika et pa sest, 'take the sides' (E5-01)
derivation: a phrase, the dual of orrowen_v2 §3.2: pa 'two' (+S; s is unchanged by the softening) + sest 'the shoulder' (*seʔst- (reserve): Hal sestos > sest, O2284), as pa yarl 'two hands'; with the article et pa sest, as et pa varn (unit S03); made for 'the sides' of a host because lern 'a side' is heard 'the face' first (blind back-translation of S11), and sest is the unit's own side (sest lo sest, O-S11-16); unit S11
